# Spectrum workshop

## Workflow

This synthetic suite exists only to test catalogue search and expansion. It does
not analyse real spectra and must not be submitted to a ToolShed.

Read the [mass filter help](mass_filter.xml) or the
[peak annotator help](peak_annotator.xml). Both wrappers use the same package.
The annotator also uses a synthetic helper dependency.

Main dependency: spectral-fixture
